name: Kuroi Tsubasa
source:
Meet Kureha Kurono and her friends in this charming visual novel! With the help of the devil Blackwing-chan they'll be able to defeat the evil shadow, right? What was that? It was Blackwing himself who caused this mess? Oh dear, oh dear.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1810000/Kuroi_Tsubasa/]Steam[/url]]
